children: FiscalNote entered into an Equity Purchase Agreement to sell its FrontierView business to Oxford Economics for up to approximately $9.4 million. The consideration includes $6.4 million in cash at closing and up to $3.0 million in earnout tied to annual recurring revenue targets as of September 30, 2026 and December 31, 2026; $1.0 million of the closing cash was placed in escrow for adjustments and indemnities. Proceeds were used to prepay $4.95 million of term loans and $0.05 million of accrued interest, and to cover transaction expenses. The transaction streamlines FiscalNote’s portfolio and supports deleveraging.
: Equity Purchase Agreement for sale of FrontierView subsidiary
